plotSections.title: Tentacles from the door
bullets: Ord, already spent and standing beside Sylan, shrugs off a grapple from a gooey tentacle reaching out of a door; a second tentacle still hits him for 19 and 12 bludgeoning.
Sylan answers with a Sentinel reaction crit on the tentacle Ord had damaged, using his +1 greatsword (including radiant damage). The cut bites deep, but tendrils still hold.

plotSections.title: Cutting the last tendrils
bullets: On his turn Sylan keeps hacking the flailing tentacles. He cannot flank a tentacle coming out of a door. One set of dark tendrils shears off the connecting point and splatters the room with black ichor, leaving one tentacle and an ominously cracked door.

He spends a Distracting Strike so the next ally to hit the remaining tentacle has advantage, then a Trip Attack he expects will not matter because the thing is very large, then another slash. Across those attacks he deals 75 damage. The last tendrils break, a stump wriggles in the doorway, and the rest falls and splatters.
Sylan warns Carlkin he is in the splash zone. Carlkin beelines for the stairs and may move up to half his movement.
Gerk is next in order. He floats opening another door so the doors could fight; that does not happen.

plotSections.title: The door answers
bullets: At the end of Sylan's turn the door uses a legendary action: it flies open and a gale-force wind blows out. The chunk ends as the wind begins.

chronologicalEvents: Ord cannot spend leftover movement to stomp the target; his bonus action and reaction are already used.
A gooey tentacle tries to grapple Ord. He contests with Athletics 25; the tie goes to him, so the tentacle wraps him and then falls away without holding.
A second tentacle hits Ord twice (19 bludgeoning, then 12 bludgeoning).
Sylan uses Sentinel when Ord is hit, crits the tentacle Ord had been damaging with his +1 greatsword, and deals 29 damage. Tendrils remain.
Sylan's turn: he keeps attacking the flailing tentacles and is told he cannot flank one coming out of a door.
His next hit (21 damage, including radiant) severs dark tendrils at the connecting point. Black ichor coats the room again. One tentacle and a cracked door remain.
He hits the last tentacle with Distracting Strike (26 plus 2 radiant). It nearly reforms, but the damage shows. The next ally to hit it has advantage.
He hits again with a Trip Attack (20 plus 3 radiant). The creature is too big for the trip to matter as he hoped, and he follows with another slash (21 plus 3 radiant).
He calls for Carlkin to take cover. Carlkin runs for the stairs.
The DM totals 75 damage from Sylan's three attacks that round. The final tendrils break; a stump wriggles in the door and the rest splatters to the floor.
Gerk, next in initiative, suggests opening another door to pit doors against each other. He does not do it.
The door takes a legendary action, flies open, and a gale-force wind blows out.

Ord.existing: Dragonborn paladin and Gatekeeper of Feldspar.
notes: Stood next to Sylan at the door while a tentacle tried to grab him.
Contested the grapple with Athletics 25. The tie went to him, so the tentacle could not hold him.
Took 19 bludgeoning and then 12 bludgeoning from the follow-up tentacle strikes.
Had already dealt over a hundred damage earlier in the same turn and had no bonus action or reaction left to stomp.
Used Sentinel to strike when an ally (Ord) was hit, critting the tentacle with a +1 greatsword for 29 damage, part of it radiant.
Could not flank a tentacle emerging from a door.
Cut one mass of tendrils free at the connecting point, splattering black ichor through the room.
Used Distracting Strike on the last tentacle so the next ally to hit it has advantage, then a Trip Attack that did not lay it out because it is very large, then a further slash.
Dealt 75 damage across three attacks in the round. That finished the visible tendrils, leaving a wriggling stump in the door.
Warned Carlkin out of the splash zone before the last cut.
Considered Action Surge to finish the fight and held off once the tendrils were already down.
quotesThemes: Warned Carlkin by name to take cover because he was in the splash zone.

Carlkin.existing: A turtle-like person believed to be back in Langdale.
notes: Is present at this fight, close enough to be in the splash zone of the tentacle.
When Sylan warned him, he beelined toward the stairs and was allowed to move up to half his movement.
Gooey tentacles reach out of a door and attack in melee. One tried to grapple Ord and failed; another struck him.
While the tentacles are not holding anyone they flail. They are too big for Sylan's trip to treat them as a normal-sized foe, and damaged tendrils can look like they reform.

Severing tendrils at the connecting point dumps black ichor that coats the room. After Sylan's round, one tentacle mass was gone and the door was ominously cracked; the last tendrils then broke, leaving a stump wriggling in the doorway.
Has a legendary action. At the end of Sylan's turn the door flew open and a gale-force wind blew out.

newTerms.name: Cracked tentacle door
notes: A hostile door in this fight that extrudes black gooey tentacles, splatters ichor when they are cut, and can take a legendary action that throws the door open into a gale.
